method: Retain the full printed upper rule from the original scan. Internal dividers use the independently measured bottom rule of the preceding panel; first-row panels retain their original uncropped outer top. Erase only above the reviewed rule, preserving its natural gaps and irregularities. Original scan-to-font affine, advance, lower separation and reviewed post-trace rotation are unchanged. No new border or pictorial content is drawn.
